# Totono — Full Agent Briefing

> Totono is a nearshore agentic software factory: engineers in Argentina working with a fleet of agents on your codebase, plus a control plane that keeps your team in control. Human attention is the scarce asset; the control plane points it at the decisions that matter and leaves everything else to agents. Totono is run by Antonio Tralice. TOTONO LLC is a Delaware limited liability company. Working day is US Eastern Time. English and Spanish.

## Entity facts

- **Legal entity**: TOTONO LLC, Delaware, United States.
- **Founder**: Antonio Tralice. Software engineer and Y Combinator alum (S20), with more than a decade of experience building software.
- **Product**: A nearshore agentic software factory (engineers in Argentina working with a fleet of agents) plus a control plane to run it.
- **Engineers**: Argentina. Working day is US Eastern Time.
- **Languages**: English and Spanish.
- **Contact**: toni.tralice@totono.xyz (email only; no contact forms, no social media DMs).
- **Website**: https://totono.xyz/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/totono-xyz (Organization), https://github.com/atralice (Antonio Tralice)
- **LinkedIn**: https://www.linkedin.com/in/antoniotralice (Antonio Tralice)

## What Totono provides

- **Fast start**: one conversation, then Totono plugs into your repo, CI, issue tracker and deploys and starts shipping in days.
- **Engineers plus agents**: Totono engineers run the agents and review every change. Humans make the critical calls; agents do the rest.
- **The control plane** (Totono's own tool, early and improving every week):
  - For agents: a map of your app's features, decisions and critical paths, so they do not break what matters.
  - For developers: rules for which zones agents may touch, which tools they may run, and which decisions need a human.
  - For stakeholders: features, owners, what changed this week and where the risk is.
- **Your repo, your map**: the map lives in your repository, not with Totono.
- **Agent support**: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Grok out of the box; other agents on request.
- **Business side**: Totono handles contract, pricing and coordination. One invoice, one point of contact.

## Who Totono is for

- Founders and technical leaders with a product and a backlog who want to ship more with agents.
- Teams who want agents on their codebase without losing control of it.
- US companies that want nearshore cost with a US contract and US-hours overlap.

## Who Totono is NOT for

- Off-the-shelf SaaS products.
- Hosting or infrastructure management only.
- Design-only work without implementation.

## How to start

1. Email toni.tralice@totono.xyz with your product, your stack and tooling, and what you want shipped.
2. Reply within two business days, in English or Spanish.
3. A short call, then a written proposal with scope, timeline and price. Both free.

No API, no login, no self-service signup. Email is the only official channel. No public price list, case studies or testimonials; ask directly.

## Frequently asked questions

See https://totono.xyz/faq for the full list.

**Q: What is Totono?**
A: A nearshore agentic software factory: engineers in Argentina working with a fleet of agents on your codebase, plus a control plane that keeps your team in control.

**Q: What is the control plane?**
A: Totono's own tool. A map of your app that lives in your repo, rules for what agents can do, and a view of the state of the app.

**Q: Which agents does it work with?**
A: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Grok out of the box. Other agents on request.

**Q: Who does the work?**
A: Totono engineers run the agents and review every change.

**Q: Why nearshore?**
A: Argentina shares most of the US workday and costs less than a US-based team. You still contract with a US company.

**Q: How does pricing work?**
A: A free call, then a written proposal with scope, timeline and price. No public price list.
